one_line: A buildable public announcements computer that lets a crew member pay 900 credits to broadcast a station-wide voice announcement, on an 11-minute shared cooldown.
player_facing_mechanics: Interact with the console to open a TGUI text box announcing the 900-credit cost
Type an announcement up to 512 characters (half of MAX_MESSAGE_LEN)
Message is passed through try_speak/treat_message, so mutes/mimes produce only '...' and speech filters (stutters, etc.) apply
Pay 900 credits from a non-departmental ID's registered bank account; failure messages if no ID, departmental card, no bank account, or insufficient funds
A several-second do_after payment/ EULA prompt must complete before the announcement fires
The announcement is broadcast to every player (minor_announce with 'Crew Announcement:' prefix) plus a deadchat broadcast naming the announcer and area
An 11-minute cooldown between announcements, shown as 'The transmitter is charging. N minutes left.'
Only usable on station Z-levels by carbons, and only one user at a time (in_use lock)
Emagged console overloads: sparks, exposes a hotspot, explodes (heavy 1, light 3, flash 4) and destroys itself
Cooldown is rounded down at roundstart to half (5.5 min) to prevent roundstart spam; STATIC_COOLDOWN_DECLARE means it persists/shared
data_only_parts: research design entry (name, desc, id, build_path, category)
logic_parts: interact() flow: operational/in_use/carbon/station-level gating, cooldown check, TGUI input, speech processing, do_after, payment, broadcast, cooldown start
pay_for_announcement(): ID card lookup, departmental-card rejection, bank account validation and credit deduction
overload_transmitters(): explosion/sparks/hotspot and Destroy() on emag use
Initialize() roundstart cooldown seed via REGISTER_REQUIRED_MAP_ITEM
byond_specific: STATIC_COOLDOWN_DECLARE / static vars (max_length, cooldown) — BYOND static var semantics
port_notes: The console maps naturally to an SS14 entity with a component holding cooldown state plus a system handling the interaction, but the credit economy (bank_account, ID-card department checks) has no direct SS14 equivalent and needs an economy/ID system port first. The TGUI text input becomes a BoundUserInterface window or an interaction DoAfter popup; minor_announce/deadchat map roughly to radio/chat events, and the do_after payment step becomes a DoAfter with a completion event. Emag overload maps to a hacking/emag-component trigger spawning an explosion via ExplosionEvent, and the design/circuitboard entries become YAML prototypes for construction and the tech-tree unlock. A human must decide: whether announcement cost/cooldown are per-console or global, how to model departmental ID rejection, and whether the static shared cooldown is intended (it is declared STATIC, so it persists across the round).
